The C++ default (linkage.hpp:51, use_knn=false) and scikit-learn's `AgglomerativeClustering(linkage="single")` are the PAIRWISE arm, which is rung 1 and is what is ported. use_knn=True RAISES BY NAME at get_distance_graph. Rung 2 would put it beside the PAIRWISE impl in connectivities.mojo and call neighbors/ported's brute-force k-NN for the graph
